Description: A fragmentary Hebrew copy of Exodus from Qumran Cave 4, catalogued as 4Q20, preserving a short plague passage (Hebrew numbering; Exodus 8 in English numbering for part of the range). Publish-prep note: Exodus 7:28-8:2 was listed in Hebrew numbering and has been converted to English KJV numbering (Exodus 8:3-6) per SBL Handbook of Style Appendix B (English/Hebrew versification table) (English Exodus 8:1-4 = Hebrew 7:26-29; English 8:5-32 = Hebrew 8:1-28).
Significance: A very small Herodian-period witness to the plagues.
